The quotation is about central government using designation powers to hold local planning authorities accountable for the speed and quality of their planning decisions, including calling in and deciding planning applications themselves.

The specific mechanism: central government oversight/accountability powers over local authority planning decision-making — this is squarely about land use regulation and planning permissions, which falls under urban/regional economics and land use regulation.

Primary: R — Urban, Rural, Regional, Real Estate, and Transportation Economics (specifically R5 — Regional Government Analysis, covering local government planning functions, and R3 — real estate/spatial production, covering planning decisions)

Secondary: H7 — State and Local Government • Intergovernmental Relations (the central-local accountability relationship is substantively important here)
